channel.title: Verbose
channel.description: Verbose for Mac: tagged releases, plus beta builds of main.

item.title: Verbose beta 247
item.description:
A new look, and fewer places to look

Mac

  • The sidebar and toolbar have the new look, with Settings at the foot of the sidebar. The sidebar is a paper gray with each place's glyph in persimmon. Back, Forward, Record, and Search or ask sit in the toolbar.
  • Templates, Ask, By day, and today's page have the new look. Cards on paper, serif titles, the kit's chips, and the persimmon tint on what you select. Plans tick off with the accent, and Send to Reminders is a sheet.
  • Dictations, Dictionary, Queue, Recently Deleted, and onboarding have the new look. So do Edit Home, the Cleaned tab's toolbar, the link card, and the Export, Add from Library, multitrack, and microphone sheets.
  • Verbose has one look. The Look setting is gone; Palette chooses full color or soft tints. Your Home keeps the sections and tiles you had in the look you used. Onboarding no longer asks you to pick a look.
  • Widgets and the Live Activity have the new look: cards, serif titles, and the record disc. This week's widget no longer has a Color option. Widgets you already placed keep working.
  • While you record, the toolbar's timer and Stop stay on transcripts too. The same goes for capturing an app's audio.
  • A project you start from the sidebar opens in the Library, ready for transcripts. The same goes for New Project in the Library's More menu. A project started from a transcript's menu still keeps you where you are.
  • Home's Dictate tile shows "Needs Accessibility" on its own line, in one piece. A state such as Drop to transcribe or On screen now sits under the tile's name too. VoiceOver reads it as a state, not a shortcut.

Also on iPhone

  • Transcripts have the new look: serif text, colored speaker chips, and a glass player.
  • The recorder has the new look: the kind in serif and a persimmon clock.
  • Minimized, a recording shows its time with Pause and Stop in the tab bar.
  • Settings has the new look: colored icons, values on the right, and switches in a card.
  • The You page shows your week, About me, your voice, and cleanup in cards.
  • Recordings use your AirPods when they're connected, at full quality on iOS 26.
  • Tap the microphone in the recorder to record from another one.
  • Home's tiles have quiet line patterns, and the record disc sits centered in its rings.
  • Clean up in Recent is a smaller text button beside the recording's title.
  • The tab bar has the new look, with Record above it on every tab but Home.
  • Thoughts, By day, Templates, Ask, Dictations, and Dictionary have the new look.
  • The keyboard has the new look: card keys, ink letters, and a persimmon dictate button.
  • A minimized recording stays in view on transcripts and Audio only recordings.
  • A recording that moves to the iPhone microphone uses that microphone's settings.
  • VoiceOver reads your words for each day of the week on the You page.
  • An answer from Ask says again how many passages and recordings it read.
